scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,STUDY,CORP -c green,cyan,blue "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:study-india" "npm run dev:corporate"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently -n STUDY,CORP -c cyan,blue "npm run dev:study-india" "npm run dev:corporate"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:study-india && npm run build:corporate
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @draa/backend run build
scripts.build:study-india: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @draa/web run build
